question_english: Which component acts as an intermediary bridge between CPU registers and primary system memory (RAM)?
explanation_english: CPU cache memory acts as a high-speed hardware bridge operating between fast internal processor registers and slower primary system RAM. Constructed using high-speed static RAM logic cells, cache memory retains frequently executed instructions and active data variables, minimizing memory bus delay times and ensuring the central processing unit avoids idle processor clock cycles while retrieving data from main RAM.

question_english: Which type of keyboard layout is the standard physical key arrangement used in computer systems globally?
